summary: PASS — Per-qty custom misc charges flow end-to-end correctly. Validated on SA-260617-163552-TEST PDF LINE ITEMS (Simple, qtys 500/1000/2000, dims 30.75x33.5, print ON). UI per-qty inputs (data-testid='misc-perqty-input-0-{0,1,2}') wire through useEngine.buildPayload → backend _resolve_misc_per_slot → calc_wf miscChargeMarkup (15%) → QuoteTable order-total-misc-0 → PreviewPdfModal By Part 'CLIPS' column AND Lump Sum descriptive lines. Regression: 2nd misc charge (Foil, flat=$80, no per-qty overrides) correctly applies the SAME $92.00 (= 80×1.15) to all 3 tiers, confirming the override-only-when-set semantics.

regression_flat_only_misc.scenario: 2nd misc 'Foil' added with treatment=Line, flat cost=80, NO per-qty overrides (costByQty={})

critical_code_review_comments: ItemSetupSec.jsx OneTimeCosts (L908-928): per-qty override block correctly gated on `mc.treatment !== 'None' && qtyTiers.length > 1`, so a single-qty quote won't show the block — good. Placeholder shows the flat cost so users see what 'blank' will inherit. Empty string clears via setMiscQty writing/removing costByQty[slot] — confirmed by blank slot 1 inheriting flat=100.

useEngine.js correctly serialises miscCharges (incl. costByQty) in both buildPayload (simple) and buildMpPayload (per component); backend engine/runner.py _resolve_misc_per_slot resolves override-else-flat per slot, then calc_wf applies miscChargeMarkup (0.15). Math verified live: 50→57.50, 100→115.00, 300→345.00.

PreviewPdfModal By Part dynamically discovers the 'Clips' miscName from row.miscLineItems[].name so custom names appear as their own column (not bucketed under generic 'Misc') — consistent with iter45 fix.

Lump Sum descriptive lines join only charge TYPES whose values are >0 per tier, so the label correctly omits 'Die' for qty 500 (where Die=0). Sum math is per-tier: misc, freight, and die summed independently per slot.

Minor enhancement (non-blocking): the per-qty inputs accept negative tabs via type='number' min='0' — confirmed min is enforced. No accessibility label (aria-label) on the small inputs; only the small qty label above is visual. Could add aria-label=`Clips override for qty ${q}` for screen readers but not required.

success_rate.backend: verified by existing pytest test_misc_per_qty.py (6/6 PASS per E1)

seed_data_creation: None — reused existing draft SA-260617-163552-TEST PDF LINE ITEMS (Simple, qtys 500/1000/2000). Test added 2 misc charges in-session (Clips with per-qty overrides + Foil flat-only) but did not Save, so the seed quote is unmodified for future test agents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-verify: login admin → toolbar-load → click load-row-204be315-8f2d-40e5-9ab5-43b2a9decdc5 (Drafts tab; saved-tab also works with load-action-open-{id}) → in One-Time Costs panel click btn-add-misc → fill name input with 'Clips' → click the 'Line' treatment tile → fill the visible number input with 100 → wait for misc-perqty-0 to appear → fill misc-perqty-input-0-0=50, misc-perqty-input-0-2=300 (leave -0-1 blank) → wait ~2s for engine debounce → click qt-row-{0,1,2} and read order-total-misc-0 (expect Clips: $57.50 / $115.00 / $345.00). Then toolbar-preview → preview-charges-by-part to see 'CLIPS' column with $57.50/$115.00/$345.00 → preview-charges-lump-sum to see preview-lumpsum-line-{0,1,2} with per-tier sums.
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix — feature validation. E1's implementation correctly threads costByQty through: (a) ItemSetupSec.OneTimeCosts addMisc seeds costByQty:{} and setMiscQty(idx, slot, val) writes/clears entries based on whether the input is non-empty; (b) the override block is gated on treatment!=='None' && qtyTiers.length>1 so single-qty quotes still see only a flat input; (c) useEngine.buildPayload/buildMpPayload pass miscCharges with the costByQty map; (d) backend engine/runner.py _resolve_misc_per_slot(miscCharges, slot_index) returns costByQty[slot_index] if present (and finite & >0 — blank/null falls through) else mc.cost; (e) calc_wf multiplies by miscChargeMarkup (0.15) producing the final line charge; (f) the row's miscLineItems carries the resolved name+amt up to QuoteTableSec order-total-misc-{i} and PreviewPdfModal By Part column / Lump Sum sum. End-to-end math verified to the cent at all 3 tiers, and the regression (no overrides → same value across tiers) is preserved.
